gen-gf-turret-road-gf-libre-franklin: Round, pen-drawn and loud: Turret Road curves like open parentheses, while Libre Franklin quietly flares its c terminals. Turret Road's line never swells anywhere, and that is its whole charm.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-livvic: Livvic reads friendly and open, its curves free of any stress. Up top, Turret Road draws bold round forms with a pen-like line of constant weight, giving a loud top and gentle bottom.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-lunasima: Loud, round, pen-drawn curves: that is Turret Road up top. Lunasima follows in sans-serif, its c tips never creeping toward touching, so the heading's bold bends get all the attention.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Bold, round, and drawn with a pen-like constant line, Turret Road makes a loud entrance. And LXGW Marker Gothic opens its c wide like a bracelet pulled apart, with a modest dip in the thin lines.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-m-plus-1: M PLUS 1 gives every e and a a big open eye, drawn with the flat line of a fineliner on paper. Beneath Turret Road's bold curves, paragraphs would drift along without snagging.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-metrophobic: Round, pen-drawn, and loud: that is Turret Road all over. Its diagonals carry as much heft as the stems, while Metrophobic does its best work gliding smoothly around each bend.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-moderustic: Moderustic reads like curves traced with a broad nib and left unfinished. Turret Road does bold, round headings best, with a pen-like line that never swells, while Moderustic does best with its open-ended curves.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-momo-trust-sans: Pure swagger up top: Turret Road's round, pen-drawn curves. Momo Trust Sans meets them with friendly bowls as sturdy as its stems and wide, unclosed mouths on curved letters.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-nanum-gothic: Round and loud, Turret Road draws parenthesis-like curves in an unshaded line, while Nanum Gothic ushers the eye into each counter. One shouts, the other guides, and the page holds together.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-national-park: Pen-drawn and unshaded, Turret Road curves like open parentheses, while National Park rounds off its letters with one open side. Let the heading take the bigger size on the page.
